selection: Demonstrated substantive expectation agreement from independently assessed experiment suites, plus principal-observation-aligned original supplied-200 cases and complete-reagent follow-ups. Successful exit alone does not qualify.

run_instructions.procedure: Write one experiment script verbatim to experiment.lab and run it in its own fresh CLI process. Do not concatenate scripts or reuse a populated interactive bench.

scope: These are saved, source-bound demonstrations, not a fresh run against current main or the deployed API. Each entry retains its tested commands and engine binding or evidence reference.
Qualitative principal-response agreement is not empirical calibration or a claim of complete chemical coverage. Read each observed_result and limitations.
Known physical failures, partial/inconclusive/unsupported assessments, identity refusals, adapted-but-unselected fixtures and expected command-rejection controls are excluded.
The recent silver/ammonia replay is excluded because canonical free/complex-bound ligand ownership remains a material gap.
Original experiment designs, forecasts and first results remain unchanged.

measure v1 balance
